about: Embedding models benchmarked by evaluation/RunBenchmark.py (GitHub workflow BenchmarkEmbeddings). 'static' models are token lookup tables averaged per text, like the shipped engine: they could ship within con-light-engine if their tokenizer is BERT WordPiece. 'transformer' models need a neural network at query time; they are measured as a quality ceiling, not as shippable options. Licenses are as stated on each model card at the time of writing; check them again before adopting a model. 'dim' truncates Matryoshka (MRL) embeddings to that width. 'queryPrefix' and 'documentPrefix' are the instructions some models expect. 'npz' candidates are built by evaluation/BuildVocabularyModels.py in the workflow and run through the plugin's own tokenizer and engine.
